exegetical_judgment: The coin establishes genuine dues; Aquinas extends its image to the person owed to God. Cyrus shows useful gifts without acknowledgment; Pauline thanksgiving shows divine gift and real human work together. The Collect then reaches willing itself, and the Eucharistic movement places received mercy before service and enduring hope.

The applications are conclusions from that progression, not an independent generic sermon.
